title: A point read that hits
note: version is 1 after the first put, not 0: it counts the puts the key has seen since it was created, which is why comparing version against 0 is how a transaction asks whether a key exists at all.

title: A point read that misses
note: This is a success, not an error. count is 0 and kvs is empty, and because a field at its zero value may be omitted, both disappear from the body entirely.
